body:
Fixes #149

Dependabot PR #135 fails because workflow tests assert the action tags it
updates. The tests now check action identity, reference pinning, inputs and
behavior, so compatible action updates pass without test edits. A new daily
health check reports bot PRs that stay open or repeatedly rebase even while
Dependabot's own jobs remain green.

## Changes and verification

| Requirement | Implementation and automated coverage |
| --- | --- |
| Permit Dependabot-owned action updates | Replaced exact action tags across cache, checkout, Python/Node setup, CodeQL, Pages, dependency review and Docker policy tests. Reference counts, required full hashes, permissions and behavior remain checked. Mutation tests reproduce #135 and simulate all tagged actions updating; floating/invalid references still fail. |
| Validate real zizmor coupling | Reads the action ref and shared CLI pin from `workflows.yml`, then checks that selected ref's upstream digest table or per-version lockfiles. Compatible updates pass; mismatches explain how to update `ZIZMOR_VERSION`. Offline tests cover both layouts and lookup failures. |
| Report stuck Dependabot PRs | Read-only daily (15:07 UTC) and manual health workflow checks all open PR pages. It fails for age strictly over 14 days or more than two rebase banners, with PR links, reasons and repair guidance in annotations/summary. Boundary, pagination, authors/state filtering, API errors, configurable thresholds and CLI exits are tested. |
| Integrate with repository gates | New workflow follows timeout, concurrency, checkout and terminal-status policies. PR runs test the health policy offline; scheduled/manual runs scan live repository health. Documentation and a Scriv release fragment are included. |

## Reproduction and root cause

Run `python -m pytest tests/test_dependabot_updates.py`. Before the fix, applying
#135's cache-v6/zizmor-action-v0.8.1 changes to temporary workflow files fails
the existing cache-v5 assertion at `tests/test_issue_118_workflows.py:51`.
The same regression passes after the fix. The original bot CI run
[43399754022](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43399754022)
confirms both cache assertions and the zizmor tag assertion fail; 755 other
tests passed. All affected tests asserted mutable maintenance choices instead
of their stated behavior. Existing checks also did not inspect aging bot PRs.

The repository has no required sub-issues or additional issue/PR feedback.
The [plan](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-149-f0c77c22b851/experiments/issue_149_plan.md)
and [verification evidence](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/issue-149-f0c77c22b851/experiments/issue_149_verification.md)
map all requirements. The health policy follows the linked
[hive-mind reference](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-4055-672ac9297a9a/scripts/dependabot-health.lib.mjs),
using this repository's standard-library/`gh` approach without new runtime dependencies.
The age threshold deliberately allows two weeks for review; a younger failing
bot PR is covered by its existing CI, and accumulated rebase banners can flag
it sooner. #135 itself remains a separate PR; its changes are exercised here.

## Validation

- 166 focused local tests passed, including workflow/concurrency and release
  policy checks. A follow-up 72-test run covered diagnostic improvements and
  negative thresholds; the final six mutation/pinning regressions also passed.
- Repository Ruff lint/format, file-size, changelog and whitespace checks pass.
- Read-only live checks confirm both zizmor-action v0.6.4 and #135's v0.8.1
  support CLI 1.30.1. The real health scan reports one bot PR and none over the
  default thresholds. `python experiments/check_issue_149_upstream.py` repeats
  compatibility verification against upstream data.
- All six workflows passed on final commit `da6666010493bdacc57e2441317ba9ed961e8561`:
  [CI/CD](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43539705020)
  (**818 passed, 1 skipped**, plus package and Docker build checks),
  [Workflows](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43539705115),
  [Security](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43539704894),
  [Docs](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43539704974),
  [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43539704903),
  and [Dependabot Health](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/actions/runs/43539704979).

## Final review

- [x] Every issue requirement has implementation and verification evidence above.
- [x] Full PR diff reviewed; existing features and security policies preserved.
- [x] Latest `main` is an ancestor of this branch; working tree is clean.
- [x] Issue comments, PR conversation, inline comments and reviews rechecked;
  no additional feedback or required sub-issues exist.
- [x] Final operational checkpoint from the plan completed: all current-head
  workflows pass and the PR is ready for review.

The PR remains unmerged. Existing release, security, link and artifact behavior
is preserved; the new Scriv fragment prepares the normal release process.
title: fix(ci): allow Dependabot action updates and report stuck bot PRs
